pricedPlanRequired: priced-plan-1.0: computed entry zone, evidence levels, stop, targets, costs, trigger and expiry
role: Independent final decision after analyst research; watchlist research decisions, never broker execution
baseline: First confirmed observed session open strictly after the Cairo decision date; same-day bars excluded conservatively
learningMode: Preserve all decisions and forward observations for later independent review; no automatic model retraining or policy changes
limitations: Price-only counterfactual observations, not actual fills or realized P/L
Daily OHLC cannot establish stop/target ordering when both are touched
Corporate actions, missing sessions and revised provider data can invalidate comparisons
No matched-period EGX benchmark series is yet available for outcome attribution
A favorable price move is not proof that a decision process was correct
